pages.text: $(bold)Jack of All Trades$() — Using 3+ different weapon types within 60 seconds grants +10% damage bonus. pages.title: The Generalist
pages.text: The $(thing)Wanderer$() is the recommended class for players who want to experience everything without committing to a role. No playstyle is penalized, and the XP bonus helps with faster progression.$(br2)$(bold)Best race pairings:$()$(br)$(thing)Human$() — Double XP bonus (+15% race + 10% class).
